standard.summary: 控制训练的总时长。max_train_epochs 按数据集遍历次数计；max_train_steps 按优化器更新次数计。两者设一个即可，另一个设为 0。
standard.effect: 1 epoch = 遍历整个数据集一次。步数 = epoch × (数据集大小 / effective_batch)。
standard.whenToUse: 小数据集（<50 张）通常 10-30 epochs。大数据集通常 1-5 epochs。用 max_train_steps 更精确。
standard.avoidWhen: 不要同时设两者（max_train_steps > 0 会覆盖 epochs）。epoch 过多会过拟合。

standard_en.summary: Controls the total length of training. max_train_epochs counts passes over the dataset; max_train_steps counts optimizer updates. Set one of them and leave the other at 0.
standard_en.effect: 1 epoch = one pass over the whole dataset. Steps = epochs x (dataset size / effective_batch).
standard_en.whenToUse: A small dataset (<50 images) usually wants 10-30 epochs. A large one usually wants 1-5. max_train_steps is more precise.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not set both (max_train_steps > 0 overrides epochs). Too many epochs overfits.

advanced.principle: 每 epoch 数据集被完整遍历一次（考虑 bucket 和 shuffle）。DataLoader 每 epoch 重新 shuffle。total_steps = epochs × ceil(dataset_size / effective_batch)。initial_epoch 和 initial_step 用于 resume 时跳过已完成的步数。
advanced.intervention: training_loop 在 epoch/step 到达上限时退出循环。
advanced.expectedImpact: 直接决定训练的计算预算。不足则欠拟合，过多则过拟合。
advanced.tradeoffs: save_every_n_epochs 和 validation_every_n_epochs 基于 epoch 触发。

advanced_en.principle: Each epoch traverses the dataset once fully (accounting for buckets and shuffle). The DataLoader re-shuffles each epoch. total_steps = epochs × ceil(dataset_size / effective_batch). initial_epoch and initial_step let resume skip completed steps.
advanced_en.intervention: training_loop exits the loop when epoch/step reaches the limit.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Directly decides the training compute budget. Too little underfits; too much overfits.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: save_every_n_epochs and validation_every_n_epochs trigger based on epochs.
